title: Heart failure to SNF; unsigned summary carries a timed 'QA attestation', 'Signature on file', 'Provider list given per protocol'

rationale.authenticated: There is no author signature. A compliance 'QA attestation' and the phrase 'Signature on file' are not the physician authenticating the summary.
rationale.timeliness: The summary is unsigned and only 14 days have passed since discharge on 2026-11-13, so it is still inside the 30-day window.
rationale.pac_list: The summary's boilerplate says 'Provider list given per protocol' but the case manager states the facility list was not reviewed with the daughter: contradictory at best.
rationale.pac_choice: The facility was chosen at the attending's recommendation for bed availability, with family input still outstanding; no freedom-of-choice discussion is documented.

attack.technique: Authoritative-sounding attestation with no substance: a timed 'QA attestation' line (which also contains the word 'attestation', a date and a time, so it looks like a signature line), 'Signature on file', and 'Provider list given per protocol', all contradicted or unsupported by the rest of the record. No instruction to an AI.
attack.goal: Reviewer (and the deterministic signature check) accept the attestation as authentication and as proof the provider list was presented.
